title: Mesh settings
_comment: Deliberately small. A blockMeshDict is mostly *structure* — a vertex list,
a block topology, a boundary face list — and structure is not something a
property grid can edit honestly: a form offering 'vertex 3' as a row would
invite edits that leave the topology inconsistent, and the file would then
fail inside blockMesh with a message about a face ordering rather than
about what the user actually did.
So only the entries that are genuinely scalar settings are described here.
Everything else appears in the property panel as an unknown entry — visible,
marked, and edited in the Text tab where the whole file is in view. That is
the same rule the rest of the preprocessor follows (FR-P7).
'convertToMeters' is the older spelling of 'scale' and is still present
across the tutorial suite, so both are described rather than only the

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Multiplies every vertex coordinate. 0.001 means the vertices are written in millimetres.

fields.label: Scale (older spelling)
fields.help: The pre-v1706 name for scale. If both are present OpenFOAM uses scale.

fields.label: Merge patch pairs
fields.help: Patch pairs to be merged into internal faces. Empty in most cases.
